data.name: Welcome_Intro
data.value: This app looks after your Valheim dedicated servers: it starts them, stops them while saving the world, switches between normal and creative mode, makes verified backups and keeps the server and the game from touching the same files.

data.name: Welcome_Hint
data.value: You can create a new world with any seed you like or use a world you already play. If a server is already running, it shows up in a notice above and can be adopted with one click.

data.name: About_ProtectionsIntro
data.value: They were born from the incident of September 16, 2026, when the server and the game opened the same world, a save was left half-written and Valheim generated a new world on top of it — wiping out the buildings.

data.name: About_GuardSaveFolderTitle
data.value: 🛡 Save folder separate from the game

data.name: About_GuardSaveFolderText
data.value: The server always gets -savedir. A profile that points to the game's folder (LocalLow\IronGate\Valheim) is refused, so the server and the game never fight over the same files.

data.name: About_GuardStopText
data.value: The server runs without a window (there's no X to close it by accident). Stopping sends Ctrl+C and waits for the log to confirm the save. Force-killing only with explicit confirmation.

data.name: About_GuardCheckText
data.value: If the latest save is incomplete (for example, missing the .db2) or a chunk is missing, the server doesn't even start. A world that doesn't exist is only created after you confirm.

data.name: About_GuardBrakeText
data.value: If the log still shows that Valheim didn't find the world data and started generating another one, the server is shut down immediately, before anything is written over it.

data.name: About_GuardBackupsText
data.value: Before starting and after stopping, the complete save is copied and checked with SHA-256. Restoring first copies the current world, moves the old folder to _substituidos and never mixes files.

data.name: About_GuardCreativeTitle
data.value: 🛡 Creative mode that really turns off

data.name: About_GuardCreativeText
data.value: The preset always goes on the command line, so the world keys are rebuilt on every start. After the first save, the app checks the world file to make sure nobuildcost is as it should be.

data.name: About_GuardLogText
data.value: The server always writes -logFile, and each session's log is archived before the next start. If something goes wrong, you can find out what happened.

data.name: About_GuardOneServerTitle
data.value: 🛡 One server per world and per port

data.name: About_GuardOneServerText
data.value: The app looks for running valheim_server processes and refuses to start another one on the same world or the same port. Servers opened outside the app are detected and can be adopted.

data.name: About_NotifyJoinsHeader
data.value: Notify me when a player joins

data.name: About_NotifyJoinsDescription
data.value: Shows a notification (from the system tray) when someone shows up in the world.

data.name: About_TrayHeader
data.value: Keep in the tray when closing

data.name: About_TrayDescription
data.value: With servers running, closing the window leaves the manager in the system tray (near the clock). When off, closing asks whether to stop the servers.
